reference_population: UK MOT pairs 2022 -> 2023, out-of-sample (3-fold cross-fitted by vehicle) scores, all ages 3-20, petrol/diesel/hybrid, interval to the next inspection standardised to 12 months

level_selection.criterion: maximum log-likelihood of a three-level step function of the observed defects (UK cross-fitted, cold variant), each level holding at least 20% of the reference vehicles

same_age_bands.lower: below the 20th percentile of vehicles of the same age
same_age_bands.higher: above the 80th percentile of vehicles of the same age
